title: How a Godly Man Stays the Same Man When No One's Watching
caption:
You've got a church version, a phone version, a group-chat version. They're not three men. They're one man with a gap he hasn't named.

A godly man doesn't manage the gap. He closes it, one honest choice at a time.

Save this for the next time you catch yourself switching.
